concept.description: Labels HTTP client methods as :OutboundCall (needsTimeout) and, except for GET reads, as :SideEffectCall.
concept.cypher: MATCH (lt:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method) WHERE lt.fqn IN ['org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate', 'org.springframework.web.client.RestClient', 'org.springframework.web.reactive.function.client.WebClient', 'java.net.http.HttpClient', 'okhttp3.OkHttpClient'] AND coalesce(m.name, last(split(split(m.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) <> '<init>' AND coalesce(m.name, last(split(split(m.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) <> '<clinit>' SET m:OutboundCall, m.needsTimeout = true WITH m WHERE NOT toLower(coalesce(m.name, last(split(split(m.signature, '(')[0], ' ')))) STARTS WITH 'get' AND NOT coalesce(m.name, last(split(split(m.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) IN ['retrieve', 'headForHeaders', 'optionsForAllow'] SET m:SideEffectCall RETURN count(DISTINCT m) AS HttpMethods

concept.description: Labels types that configure connect / read timeouts on their client as :TimeoutConfigured.
concept.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method)-[:INVOKES]->(c:Method) WHERE toLower(coalesce(c.name, last(split(split(c.signature, '(')[0], ' ')))) =~ '.*(connecttimeout|readtimeout|responsetimeout|connectionrequesttimeout|sockettimeout|timeout).*' SET t:TimeoutConfigured RETURN count(DISTINCT t) AS TimeoutConfiguredTypes

constraint.description: An HTTP client created in code must be configured with connect and read timeouts.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method)-[:INVOKES]->(c:Method)<-[:DECLARES]-(ct:Type) WHERE NOT t:Test AND NOT t:TimeoutConfigured AND ct.fqn IN ['org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate', 'org.springframework.web.client.RestClient', 'org.springframework.web.reactive.function.client.WebClient', 'java.net.http.HttpClient', 'okhttp3.OkHttpClient'] AND coalesce(c.name, last(split(split(c.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) = '<init>' RETURN DISTINCT m AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, ct.fqn AS Detail
